subject: Interim SRE coverage and performance calibration — freeze exception request
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Interim SRE coverage and freeze exception for L3 vacancy

Ava,

Quick context: An L3 SRE on the Realtime Serving team gave notice yesterday for a last day in three weeks. We are still under the current hiring freeze, but the role is critical for our latency SLOs and upcoming EMEA launch. I want to request a short-term backfill exception (12 weeks) while we evaluate whether to convert to permanent headcount or redistribute responsibilities.

As part of the exception, I need:
- A 12-week interim coverage plan (who covers oncall, critical runbook owners)
- Evidence of a recent performance calibration for the role (to justify conversion vs. tapering)
- Cost estimate (contractor vs. redeploy)

Can you draft the interim plan and a quick risk matrix? I'll need HR sign-off and VP approval. Looping Mina for HR criteria.

Thanks,

Laura
Director, Realtime Serving
Redwood Inference
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interim SRE coverage and freeze exception for L3 vacancy

Laura,

Thanks — I put together a short interim coverage plan and attached a performance summary from the last calibration cycle. Highlights:

- Coverage: 3 engineers (Marcus-approved) rotate oncall; primary runbook owners assigned to Marcus, Karthik, and Priya (see roster).
- Risk mitigation: increase paging thresholds during peak deploy days; retain vendor on-call for critical rollback support (contractor cost ~ $9k/week).
- Performance: The departing engineer rated Strong Contributor in 2026 Q2 calibration; notes included in performance-summary-2026Q2.pdf.
- Timeline: 12-week exception requested; end date proposal 2026-11-22 with checkpoint at week 6.

Attachments: interim-coverage-roster.xlsx, performance-summary-2026Q2.pdf, org-chart-v2.png

Questions for HR/Finance:
- Is a contractor purchase order sufficient for the 12-week window, or do we need a headcount carveout?
- If headcount carveout, will this require a transfer from another team budget or an exception to the freeze?

I implemented an ops-only contingency that doesn't expand permanent HC until we have the run-rate after EMEA launch. I can convert this into a short mutual action plan if that helps (owners, dates, acceptance criteria).

—Ava
Senior Manager, Site Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-31T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interim SRE coverage and freeze exception for L3 vacancy

Team,

HR can approve a time-limited exception under the following conditions:

1) Clear business impact and mitigation plan (we have the coverage doc attached, good start).
2) A defined end date and a 6-week checkpoint with quantitative SLO/operational metrics.
3) Budget owner signoff for contractor spend OR a formal headcount carveout request with Finance.
4) No permanent role creation without a re-authorization process post-checkpoint.

Please attach the latest calibration notes for the departing engineer (for audit). Also confirm whether the contractor will be engaged through Pacific Talent Partners (I can expedite SOW review) or via an internal PO.

If you prefer, HR can draft the exception letter for exec signature once the 6-week checkpoint metrics are defined.

Mina
Head of People Ops
Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-09-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interim SRE coverage and freeze exception for L3 vacancy — approved conditional

All,

I reviewed Ava's plan and Mina's conditions. I approve a 12-week exception with the following constraints:

- Contractor route via Pacific Talent Partners approved; cap weekly spend at $10k. Ava to provide PO details by EOD Thursday.
- 6-week checkpoint is required. KPIs: mean time to restore (MTTR) for high sev incidents, oncall burn (pager count), and deploy failure rate. If KPIs degrade >15% vs baseline, we revisit and may extend or reassign.
- No backfill to permanent HC without a formal business case and headcount reauthorization from Finance.

Ava, please post the mutual action plan to the Drive link and tag SRE-1234 in Jira for tracking. Once PO is in place and Mina provides the exception letter, consider this approved.

Marcus
VP, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
